Hosting is secure and compliant when two things line up.

The platform hardens the infrastructure (network isolation, firewall, patching, encryption in transit, backups) and you handle the app-level parts (your code, who has access, what data you collect and keep). That division is the shared-responsibility model. No host can be compliant on your behalf.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/secure-compliant-hosting/
